concept: One chrome hand tally counter lying on a chalk-pink table, rendered in 3D (Blender) and shot from the same side three ways. Wide: it has counted 0047, but how did they find you? Right up against the number window: you know how many, not where from. Nearer and higher: the same counter now carries a strip of green embossed label tape reading GOOGLE, because someone asked. Chalk pink, polished chrome, black number wheels and one green label.
